invariants: all public stateful operations use inherent instance methods
status codes are limited to the RFC 9110 range 100 through 599
reason phrases and field values reject CR LF and other invalid bytes
field names use HTTP token syntax and preserve caller order and duplicates
Content-Length Transfer-Encoding Connection and Trailer have one framing owner
head field-name field-value and field-count limits are independently bounded
the complete automatic suffix is bounded before finish mutates the writer
Content-Length is generated from explicit body length rather than inferred storage
HEAD and 304 suppress body transmission while retaining representation length
informational 204 and successful CONNECT responses omit Content-Length
successful CONNECT is exposed as a tunnel disposition
HTTP 1.0 persistent responses explicitly emit keep-alive while HTTP 1.1 persistence is implicit
close mode emits Connection close only on final responses
the response head owns only head bytes and body storage remains caller owned
finish consumes the writer and intoBytes transfers the existing head buffer without copying
unsupported: persistent request orchestration beyond the bounded one-request close mode
streaming or chunked response bodies and trailers
